Game Overview

HuggyBros Christmas is a fire and water title where join the Huggy brothers on a festive quest brimming with colorful challenges. Navigate perilous terrains, collect sparkling costumes, and unlock secrets by mastering clever double jumps. With engaging levels, wintery delights, and intuitive controls, HuggyBros Christmas promises a whimsical holiday adventure for all.
